entities.summary: Nyaung-yan Min or Neow-ram Min, personal name Shin Thissah (ရှင်သစ္စာ), courtesy name Min-Yeh Nandamate (မင်းရဲနန္ဒိမိတ်), was king of the Toungoo dynasty of Burma (Myanmar) from 1599 to 1605. He is also referred to as the founder of the restored Toungoo dynasty or Nyaungyan dynasty for starting the reunification process following the collapse of the First Toungoo Empire.
